what_this_is: A derived index, not evidence. runs.ndjson stores no stratum and no timezone; this file records the collection machine's UTC offset, how it was established, and the block-to-stratum map that follows from it. runs.ndjson is unmodified and must stay so.

offset_established_by.method: collect.py stamps every log line with a naive datetime.now(); each 'block finished' line follows that block's last record, whose epoch time is in the NDJSON. Reading the stamp as UTC and subtracting the record's finished_at_unix gives offset + write-lag. The offset is the unique quarter-hour value leaving every lag in [0, 120) seconds.

assignment_rule: stratum = the local-time hour bucket of the earliest started_at_unix among the block's records, which is exactly what collect.census() did when it decided the collection was finished.
